periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axis tilted approximately 45 degrees toward the medial facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with the longitudinal axis significantly greater than the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating a teardrop-like extension below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a broad, gentle curve across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thick band spanning approximately 20-25% of the visible dorsal torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular top boundaries without visible flattening.
